Add an authorization check after authentication that: (1) Verifies the team exists, (2) Checks if team.owner_id === userId OR memberships contains an active record for team_id and user_id with role === 'admin' or 'owner', (3) If neither matches, returns 403 Forbidden with standard { error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Forbidden: only team owners or admins can send invitations' } }, (4) If passed, proceeds with invitation creation. Do NOT change existing validation or response formatting.
